entry.title: Add Step 5 Preview to NVIDIA NIM provider (#10082)
entry.content:
Add Step 5 Preview to NVIDIA NIM provider (#10082)

* Add Step 5 Preview to NVIDIA NIM

Override-only entry with base_model stepfun/step-5-preview.
NIM deltas sourced from the NIM chat schema and catalog card:
- reasoning always on, no caller control (enable_thinking const true, no reasoning_effort) -> reasoning_options = []
- reasoning_content side channel -> [interleaved]
- text + up to 8 images, no video/audio -> [modalities]
- structured output not supported on NIM -> structured_output = false
- context / max_tokens 1,048,576 -> [limit]
- free NVIDIA API trial tier -> cost 0.0/0.0

https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/stepfun-ai-step-5-preview-infer
https://build.nvidia.com/stepfun-ai/step-5-preview

* Mark Step 5 Preview weights as published on Hugging Face

Open weights were published 2026-10-14/15 under StepFun Model License 1.0:
https://huggingface.co/stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview
The NIM card links these weights too. Without this fix the new nvidia
entry inherits open_weights = false and renders as Closed.

* Address audit: declare NIM reasoning_effort control, align [limit]

The published OpenAPI omits reasoning controls, but the endpoint validates
a top-level reasoning_effort enum: an invalid value is rejected with
"expected one of none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max" (probed
2026-10-16 against integrate.api.nvidia.com). reasoning_effort=none
suppresses the reasoning_content side channel; max yields the longest
reasoning (both verified live). chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking is
const true in the schema and does not stop reasoning generation (probe:
completion_tokens unchanged), so it is not a toggle.

[limit] output = 1,048,576 is the server-enforced max_tokens cap
(1,048,577 is rejected with "Max tokens must not exceed 1048576"); input
aligned with context. No separate lower output cap is published for the
NIM route (StepFun's 64k output cap applies to their first-party API).

entry.title: provider(upstage): add Solar Mini 4 (#10155)
entry.content:
provider(upstage): add Solar Mini 4 (#10155)

Upstage retires solar-mini on 2026-10-30 (KST) and names solar-mini4
as its replacement. Add the lab and first-party provider entries in
the same format as solar-pro4: 512K context, 128K output, reasoning
effort none..max, list price 0.10 / 0.01 cached / 0.40 per 1M tokens.
